subject: Request: Permission to use Acure Health quote & logo in customer story
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@acurehealth.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 8 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Permission to use Acure Health quote & logo in customer story

Hi Marta —

Thanks again for the time last week. As discussed, we drafted a short customer one-pager and a case-study blurb that highlights the latency and cost savings you achieved running clinical summarization pipelines on our dedicated inference pool. Would Acure be willing to: 

- Approve a short customer quote (one to two sentences) we can use on our website and in sales collateral
- Provide a high-res logo and any required usage guidelines
- Confirm there are no regulatory or procurement constraints on publishing this material

I've attached the draft one-pager for context (draft_one-pager.pdf) and a proposed quote we pulled from our interview (below). If you prefer different wording, happy to update. If OK, we can send a short permission form for signature.

Proposed short quote (editable):
"Redwood Inference helped us reduce end-to-end summarization latency by 3x while cutting per-patient inference spend by ~45%, letting our team scale clinical workflows without compromise."

Next steps: if you can loop in whoever owns legal/PR at Acure and share logo assets, we can move this to a sign-off step.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0199

Attachment: draft_one-pager.pdf

From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@acurehealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Benjamin Cruz <ben.cruz@acurehealth.com>, contracts@acurehealth.com
Date: Mon, 9 Feb 2026 10:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Permission to use Acure Health quote & logo in customer story

Hi Jonas —

Appreciate the draft. We like the story direction, but legal flagged two items: 

1) We cannot publish the ~45% cost figure as a standalone claim without a short methodology note. Could we either remove the percentage or add a parenthetical that references the internal baseline and timeframe?
2) We prefer a simpler quote that doesn't mention specific savings numbers. Proposed replacement quote attached in the redline (redline_acure_case_study.docx).

Benjamin from Legal is CC'd — he'll route this to procurement/contracts for a short permission form. Also, I'll ask Marketing to send our official high-res logo set and the logo usage guide (we typically require the PDF guidelines be included whenever the logo is used).

We can sign an approval form but prefer to review the final one-pager before signing.

Best,
Marta Lopez
Head of Product, Acure Health
marta.lopez@acurehealth.com

Attachment: redline_acure_case_study.docx

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 08:20:00 -0800
Subject: FW: Request: Permission to use Acure Health quote & logo in customer story

Jonas / Marissa —

Looping Legal and Comms guidance here. Olga, please confirm the minimum items we need before we send an official permission form back to Acure: 
- Finalized quote (client-approved wording)
- High-res logo in SVG + PNG and the Acure logo usage PDF
- Confirmation there are no sensitive metrics (or a short methodology line if they want numbers included)

Marissa — once we have the final quote and assets, can we schedule a quick visual review for layout/branding? I'd like the one-pager to include a single-callout quote and a small methodology note if we keep numeric claims.

Jonas — when you get the signed permission form, please upload it to the Drive link and drop the DocuSign URL into the thread.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett | Sr. Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@acurehealth.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Permission to use Acure Health quote & logo in customer story

Hi Marta —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the redline. Per Benjamin's suggestion, we've removed the specific percentage and replaced it with the shorter line you proposed. Draft quote now reads: 

"Working with Redwood Inference helped us reduce inference latency and lower per-patient inference costs, enabling faster, more scalable clinical reviews."

I've attached a short permission form for signature (signed_permission_form.pdf stub) and included a .zip with high-res logo files (acure_logo_highres.zip) — please treat these as placeholders until we receive your official kit.

If everything looks good, please sign the permission form at the DocuSign link below or return a countersigned PDF. Once signed, we'll finalize the one-pager and send a visual for your marketing review.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/abcdef-approval-acure
Drive draft: https://drive.redwood.com/s/Acure-case-study-draft

Thanks again — appreciate the partnership.

Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0199

Attachments: signed_permission_form.pdf (for signature), acure_logo_highres.zip (logo kit placeholder)
